title: Complex controls and infotainment refinement
summary: Feedback centers on the G60 feeling complex in its controls, software, manuals, and electronic features, with only limited explicit praise for the infotainment and driving experience.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the infotainment overall while noting complexity in finding features.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention complex controls, overly complex software and manuals, electronic features needing refinement, and driving praised separately from complexity concerns.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the sentiment direction for this topic is often unclear.
The topic mixes interface complexity, manual clarity, refinement needs, and separate comments about driving quality, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Examples are limited, so stronger conclusions about which specific systems drive the feedback are not supported.
